issues.explanation: In “二十岁,” this indicates age or “years old,” not merely “year.”
奉命 is a natural lexical word meaning to receive or act under orders; splitting it into 奉 and 命 hides the useful expression.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 奉命, pinyin fèngmìng, meaning “to receive orders; under orders to”.

issues.explanation: 北返 is a natural compound meaning to return north; splitting it into 北 and 返 obscures the intended lexical unit.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 北返, pinyin běifǎn, meaning “to return north.”

issues.explanation: Here 他 is the object pronoun referring to 董卓, not merely a grammatical label for third-person singular.
